blocks.text: Surface tension liquids ki woh property hai jo liquid ki satah (surface) ke saath lagne wali force ko batati hai; is force ki wajah se satah ek lachakdar (elastic) chadar ki tarah bartao karti hai. Yeh force satah ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces se paida hoti hai.

Satah ke molecules ko intermolecular forces kul mila kar andar ki taraf khinchti hain, is liye satah par ek "jhilli" (skin) si ban jati hai. Surface tension ki wajah se liquid apna surface area kam se kam rakhna chahta hai; isi liye qatre (droplets) gol (sphere) bante hain. Capillary action, cheezon ka geela hona (wetting), aur qatron aur bulbulon ka banna, sab par surface tension ka asar hai. Machhar (mosquito) pani ki zyada surface tension ki wajah se pani par khara reh sakta hai.
Surface tension par asar karne wale factors

items: Temperature: temperature barhne se surface tension aam taur par kam hoti hai (molecules tez hilte hain, kashish kamzor parti hai).
Intermolecular forces: jitni mazboot intermolecular forces, utni zyada surface tension.

blocks.caption: Table 5.3 20 °C par kuch liquids ki surface tension (N m⁻¹)

blocks.text: Table mein ‘γ’ (gamma) ki values 10⁻³ (yani 1/1000) ki multiple hain. Maslan 20 °C par pani (H₂O) ki γ = 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹, ya 72.75 dynes cm⁻¹.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table mein pani ki surface tension (72.75) baqi sab se taqreeban teen guna hai, kyunke pani ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bonds se mazbooti se jure hain. Quick Check 5.5 (a), jo surface tension ke bare mein hai, kitab topic 5.6.1 ke baad chhapti hai; us ka jawab wahin hai.

items: Surface tension (γ, N m⁻¹): satah ke molecules par andar ki taraf kul force, jis se satah elastic chadar jaisi; qatre gol, capillary action, wetting, bulbule.
Temperature barhe to kam, intermolecular forces mazboot hon to zyada (pani 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹, ethanol 22.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹).
